title: Evaluator output
description: What one evaluator call returns for one answer. Schema failure: retry once (core.ai.generate_json does this), then store with needs_review true. Quote failure: see evidence_checker rules in api.md.

score.description: Upper bound is the rubric's score_max, checked in code because JSON Schema cannot see the rubric.

evidence_quote.description: Exact text copied from the transcript. Empty string only when score is 0 and nothing in the answer addresses the criterion.

evidence_span.description: [start, end) character offsets into the transcript string given to the evaluator. [0, 0] when evidence_quote is empty.

needs_review.description: Set by our code, never by the model, when retries or the evidence check failed.
